title: J. The Power of the Sun

legend: Dr. Otto Octavius is a brilliant nuclear physicist working on his life's work: a sustainable fusion power source. He claims to have "the power of the sun, in the palm of his hand" with his new Infinite Factorial Reactor.
The reactor consists of n$$$n$$$ fusion cores lined up in a row, indexed from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$. Initially, the i$$$i$$$-th core holds an energy level of ai$$$a_i$$$.
Octavius uses his mechanical arms to conduct q$$$q$$$ operations. In each operation, he interacts with a specific range of cores [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$. The operations are of two types:

Fusion Ignition: Octavius triggers a reaction in the cores from index l$$$l$$$ to r$$$r$$$. The energy level of every core in this range transforms into its own factorial. Formally, for each i$$$i$$$ such that l≤i≤r$$$l \le i \le r$$$, the energy level ai$$$a_i$$$ becomes ai!$$$a_i!$$$ (where 0!=1$$$0! = 1$$$ and x!=1×2×⋯×x$$$x! = 1 \times 2 \times \dots \times x$$$ for x≥1$$$x \ge 1$$$).

Stability Check: Octavius measures the total energy output of the cores from index l$$$l$$$ to r$$$r$$$. However, the inhibitor chip has a limit and can only display the result modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$. Formally, the reading is (∑ri=lai)(mod998244353)$$$\left(\sum_{i=l}^{r} a_i\right) \pmod{998244353}$$$.
Help Dr. Octavius simulate the reactor's behavior and determine the energy readings for all type 2 operations.
input: The first line contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤105$$$1 \le t \le 10^5$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n,q≤5⋅105$$$1 \le n, q \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of fusion cores and the number of operations.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ (0≤ai≤5⋅105$$$0 \le a_i \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the initial energy levels of the cores.

Each of the next q$$$q$$$ lines contains three integers type$$$type$$$, l$$$l$$$, r$$$r$$$ (type∈{1,2}$$$type \in \{1, 2\}$$$, 1≤l≤r≤n$$$1 \le l \le r \le n$$$) — describing an operation of the corresponding type on the range [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 5⋅105$$$5 \cdot 10^5$$$ and the sum of q$$$q$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 5⋅105$$$5 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each operation of type 2$$$2$$$, print a single integer — the sum of energy levels in the range modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.

legend.ai: 奥托·奥克塔维斯博士是一位杰出的核物理学家，正在研究他毕生的事业：一种可持续的聚变能源。他声称，借助全新的无限阶乘反应堆，他拥有“掌中太阳之力”。
反应堆由 n$$$n$$$ 个排成一列的聚变核心组成，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$。初始时，第 i$$$i$$$ 个核心的能量值为 ai$$$a_i$$$。
奥克塔维斯使用机械臂执行 q$$$q$$$ 次操作。每次操作中，他都会对核心的特定区间 [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$ 进行操作。操作有以下两种类型：

聚变点火：奥克塔维斯触发编号从 l$$$l$$$ 到 r$$$r$$$ 的核心中的反应。该范围内每个核心的能量值都会变为其自身的阶乘。形式化地，对于满足 l≤i≤r$$$l \le i \le r$$$ 的每个 i$$$i$$$，能量值 ai$$$a_i$$$ 会变为 ai!$$$a_i!$$$(其中 0!=1$$$0! = 1$$$，且当 x≥1$$$x \ge 1$$$ 时，x!=1×2×⋯×x$$$x! = 1 \times 2 \times \dots \times x$$$)。
稳定性检查：奥克塔维斯测量编号从 l$$$l$$$ 到 r$$$r$$$ 的核心的总能量输出。然而，抑制器芯片存在限制，只能显示对 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 取模后的结果。形式化地，读数为 (∑ri=lai)(mod998244353)$$$\left(\sum_{i=l}^{r} a_i\right) \pmod{998244353}$$$。
请帮助奥克塔维斯博士模拟反应堆的运行过程，并确定所有类型 2 操作的能量读数。

每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$ (1≤n,q≤5⋅105$$$1 \le n, q \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$) —— 融合核心的数量和操作的数量。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ (0≤ai≤5⋅105$$$0 \le a_i \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$) —— 核心的初始能量等级。
接下来的 q$$$q$$$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 type$$$type$$$、l$$$l$$$、r$$$r$$$ (type∈{1,2}$$$type \in \{1, 2\}$$$、1≤l≤r≤n$$$1 \le l \le r \le n$$$) —— 描述在区间 [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$ 上执行的相应类型的操作。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 5⋅105$$$5 \cdot 10^5$$$，且所有测试用例中 q$$$q$$$ 的总和不超过 5⋅105$$$5 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个类型为 2$$$2$$$ 的操作，输出一个整数 —— 区间内能量等级之和对 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
